# Brief: Reorder Three

## Idea

A weekly email that tells a small shop owner which three products to reorder, from their existing point-of-sale export, with no dashboard.

## Problem and root-cause chain

Idea: a reorder email. Why: shop owners run out of their best sellers. Why: they reorder from memory. Why: their point-of-sale system shows data but not decisions. Root cause: the tool reports, it does not recommend. This chain reaches a root cause.

## User

Priya, 44, owns one gift shop, exports a sales CSV every Monday, and never opens the dashboard that came with her till.

## Success metric and leading indicator

Twenty paying shops by 2026-12-31 with fewer than five stock-outs a month each. Leading indicator: ten shops forward the first email to a supplier.

## Comparable products

Pending: the market pass did not run for this fixture.

## Scope

Smaller first version: one CSV format, one email a week, three items, no dashboard. It leaves out multi-store and the supplier integration. It would still move the number. Recommendation: build the smaller version. Decision: open.

## Non-goals

- No dashboard.
- No inventory counting hardware.

## Open questions for the author

- Which point-of-sale export format first? Assumption: Square.
